purpose: Tablist container inside a tabs composite that wraps tab triggers and exposes the ARIA tablist role with orientation metadata.
useWhen: Wrapping a row or column of tab triggers inside a tabs ancestor.
Providing the accessible label or labelledby reference for the tablist landmark.

avoidWhen.reason: Used outside a tabs ancestor — the component throws at construction.
Rendering tab-panel content — keep panels as siblings outside the tab-list.
